title: Acceptable Use of Systems and AI Tools
scope: Applies to Business Analysts during their first 30 days.
summary: Defines responsible use of systems and generative AI tools.
details: Do not enter sensitive data into public AI tools without approval.
Review AI output for accuracy, bias and confidentiality.
escalation: Raise a Security or Access Request ticket for uncertainty.
exceptions: Any exception requires documented approval from the policy owner.
keywords: acceptable use of systems and ai tools
